titulo: Trade-facilitating measures help offset rise in new G20 trade restrictions
cuerpo: The number of tariff increases and other non-facilitating trade measures introduced by G20 economies rose sharply in the first half of 2026, and the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO's latest report on G20 trade measures. At the same time, G20 economies, representing around 80-85 per cent of global GDP and 75 per cent of international trade, introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to reinforce global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
